source.title: Robonine: Feetech STS3250 Smart Actuator: Evaluation of Accuracy, Torque and Backlash

claims.source: Feetech datasheet limit of 0.5 deg or less, as quoted by Robonine

notes: Mechanical backlash of 0.43 deg, within the 0.5 deg specification. A different method from the HardwareX test stand, so the two are not directly comparable.
